original.target_description: Original Fiorito and Kollintzas (2004) primary full text unavailable; supplied original locator cannot be verified independently.

replication.target_description: Relationship between disposable income and consumption, examining transient income effects relative to the permanent income model (Column 3, Table 5, augmented by disposable income). Same-period replication (1970–1996), not the 1996–2015 extension; difference-GMM model of private consumption.

n.sample_role: Country-year observations in the 1970–1996 difference-GMM estimation, across 12 OECD countries
n.exclusions: Unbalanced reconstructed data; missing historical observations documented on pp. 6–8. Table-specific estimation observations reported; an exact exclusion breakdown for this specification is not printed.

notes: Original acquisition terminal miss recorded at texts/21ae3ca30ea09cd7c1aecb17.miss (DOI, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, and archive routes unsuccessful); no original statistics copied from secondary reproduced F&K columns. Replication coefficient is printed, while a coefficient-specific t/z test statistic is not printed; parenthesized numbers are Newey-West standard errors, not test statistics. J-test chi-square and p-values test instrument validity and are not the target coefficient test. P threshold follows the coefficient significance stars and the printed two-sided legend; no exact p-value is printed. Reported success records the author’s explicit paper-wide verdict, not a coefficient-specific inferred verdict. Tables 6–8 captions say Equation (6), while their income-augmented variables and p. 10 identify the augmented model (Equation (7)).
